title: Structural Basis of Mutation-Dependent p53 Tetramerization Deficiency.
authors: Rigoli, Marta; Spagnolli, Giovanni; Lorengo, Giulia; Monti, Paola; Potestio, Raffaello; Biasini, Emiliano; Inga, Alberto
one_liner_zh: 该文通过全原子分子动力学模拟结合酵母功能实验，研究p53四聚化结构域突变对转录因子功能及DNA结合特异性的影响，属于TF-DNA互作机制研究，但方法以MD为主且功能验证偏重实验，AI方法缺失。
abstract: The formation of a tetrameric assembly is essential for the ability of the tumor suppressor protein p53 to act as a transcription factor. Such a quaternary conformation is driven by a specific tetramerization domain, separated from the central DNA-binding domain by a flexible linker. Despite the distance, functional crosstalk between the two domains has been reported. This phenomenon can explain the pathogenicity of some inherited or somatically acquired mutations in the tetramerization domain, including the widespread R337H missense mutation present in the population in south Brazil. In this work, we combined computational predictions through extended all-atom molecular dynamics simulations with functional assays in a genetically defined yeast-based model system to reveal structural features of p53 tetramerization domains and their transactivation capacity and specificity. In addition to the germline and cancer-associated R337H and R337C, other rationally designed missense mutations targeting a significant salt-bridge interaction that stabilizes the p53 tetramerization domain were studied (i.e., R337D, D352R, and the double-mutation R337D plus D352R). The simulations revealed a destabilizing effect of the pathogenic mutations within the p53 tetramerization domain and highlighted the importance of electrostatic interactions between residues 337 and 352. The transactivation assay, performed in yeast by tuning the expression of wild-type and mutant p53 proteins, revealed that p53 tetramerization mutations could decrease the transactivation potential and alter transactivation specificity, in particular by better tolerating negative features in weak DNA-binding sites. These results establish the effect of naturally occurring variations at positions 337 and 352 on p53's conformational stability and function.
abstract_zh: 四聚体组装的形成对于肿瘤抑制蛋白p53作为转录因子的能力至关重要。这种四级构象由特定的四聚化结构域驱动，该结构域通过柔性连接子与中央DNA结合结构域分隔。尽管存在距离，但两个结构域之间的功能性串扰已有报道。这一现象可以解释四聚化结构域中某些遗传性或体细胞获得性突变的致病性，包括巴西南部人群中广泛存在的R337H错义突变。在本研究中，我们结合通过扩展全原子分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟的计算预测与基于基因定义的酵母模型系统中的功能分析，揭示了p53四聚化结构域的结构特征及其反式激活能力和特异性。除了种系和癌症相关的R337H和R337C外，还研究了其他理性设计的错义突变，这些突变靶向稳定p53四聚化结构域的关键盐桥相互作用（即R337D、D352R以及双突变R337D加D352R）。模拟揭示了致病突变在p53四聚化结构域内的去稳定效应，并强调了残基337和352之间静电相互作用的重要性。通过调节野生型和突变型p53蛋白表达在酵母中进行的反式激活分析显示，p53四聚化突变可降低反式激活潜力并改变反式激活特异性，特别是在弱DNA结合位点中更好地耐受负面特征。这些结果确立了337和352位点自然发生的变异对p53构象稳定性和功能的影响。
